summary: The audit response at eafec66 correctly specifies the Stage 3 construction requirements raised by C1–C7 and makes no false completion claims. The read-only helper's 24-byte header unpack matches the Dgram/Xtc layout, its service decode matches Dgram.hh, and source_preflight.json contains 70 templates, 10 identical run identities and all-false Enable chunkinfo, matching the supplied execution evidence. Stage 3/4 remain explicitly unexecuted. One low, non-blocking text inaccuracy: C7's response says eleven Stage 1/2 note files while the evidence lists ten plus the plan.
